session_grid: authoritative calendar open_at exclusive through close_at inclusive; 09:01 labels [09:00,09:01), 13:30 labels [13:29,13:30)
complete_proof_requirement: AUTHORITATIVE_FULL_SESSION_GRID_V1 with every expected bar-end label
replay: offline reader validates calendar binding, canonical artifact hash, ordered bars, coverage evidence and archive identity; no network
derived_metrics: path-dependent metrics require COMPLETE; sparse or partial observations yield INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
observed_path_consumer: 15:00 may present SPARSE_UNVERIFIED as observed-only evidence with provenance, coverage and missingness; it must not claim complete intraday path, verified high/low, first touch, occupancy, MFE or MAE
1700_integration: design-only: immutable observed evidence may be diagnostic only until a separately approved scoring contract exists
